g.text: F I X C H E C K O U T 5 0 0 E R R O R
The 500 comes from a missing tax-rate row for the three new regions (CL, PE,
UY); checkout calls the rate service and gets nothing back.
Hotfix PR #412 adds the rows and a guard that falls back to the default
rate, with an alert when it does.
If the fix is not green by end of day, roll back deploy 2026.09.27.
